stories.text: The Crimean Bridge is struck by Ukrainian forces for the third time in four days, prompting Russian authorities to close the bridge to all traffic.
Salvadoran forces destroy a house belonging to Jeff Larose, the leader of the Taliban gang that operates in Canaan, Haiti. The Gang Suppression Force says it was not involved.
Two Bangladesh Nationalist Party members are killed when suspected members of the banned Awami League attack a motorcycle procession in Kalia, Narail District, Bangladesh.

In Bangladesh, a crowd allegedly led by Chatra Dal members storms and sets fire to the residence of former Awami League Member of Parliament Shamim Osman in Fatullah, Narayanganj District, while unidentified attackers in Nazirpur, Pirojpur District, loot and set fire to two houses belonging to former Minister of Fisheries and Livestock and Awami League leader SM Rezaul Karim, and a crowd in Sirajganj vandalises the local Awami League office and the residence of former MP Habibe Millat.

In Gopalganj District, Bangladesh, armed members of the banned Awami League, Chhatra League, and Jubo League detonate crude bombs and set fire to a private clinic owned by BNP Member of Parliament K M Babar of Gopalganj-2, forcing patients to evacuate. Attackers also burn at least five BNP offices across Muksudpur and Kashiani and target two Grameen Bank branches.

The Israeli army launches its first operation in central Gaza Strip amid the displacement of families from the area, for the first time since the ceasefire agreement signed in October 2025 came into effect.

A Lashkar-e-Taiba commander is killed by the Indian Armed Forces at a mosque in Kulgam district, Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, after escaping a shootout with troops two days earlier in a neighboring village, where his associate was killed.

Vincent van Gogh's 1890 painting Blossoming Chestnut Trees sells for US$190.4 million at Sotheby's in New York City, United States, setting a new auction record for Van Gogh and surpassing the $117.2 million paid for Orchard with Cypresses (1888) in 2022.

In Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia, Bangladesh, thousands of garment workers demanding a monthly minimum wage increase from ৳12,500 (US$100) to ৳30,000 ($240) block the Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway and set fire to a police vehicle, causing police to fire tear gas and stun grenades in Gazipur and Ashulia as 55 factories close across the three areas, while police report around 300 arrests across 24 cases filed in Savar and Ashulia during the protests.

In Kafrul, Dhaka, police fire around ten stun grenades against demonstrating garment workers following clashes with Bangladesh Nationalist Party activists who allegedly harassed female factory employees, causing workers to stage demonstrations and halt production at several nearby garment factories.
Arsonists set fire to the ancestral home of former chief adviser Muhammad Yunus in Panchlaish, Chattogram, Bangladesh.
NASA's space probe Voyager 1 reaches the distance of one light-day from Earth, being the first man-made object to reach that distance, after it launched in 1977.
PlayStation reports a major outage ahead of the release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

stories.topic: Bangladeshi cricket team in South Africa in 2026–27
stories.text: In Test cricket, Bangladeshi wicketkeeper Litton Das sets a world record for the most dismissals in a single Test innings, recording six catches and two stumpings against South Africa in Johannesburg.
